EC1: 1. Taking a tetracycline within 6 months or history of adverse reaction to minocycline [OR] or another tetracycline.
EC2: 2. Enhanced risk from lumbar puncture, including documented [OR] or suspected cerebral mass lesion predisposing to brain herniation [OR] or bleeding diathesis.
EC3: 3. Pregnancy [OR] or expectation of pregnancy during the study.
EC4: 4. Active opportunistic infection [OR] or active neurological disease that might confound evaluation.
EC7: 7. BUN [OR] or creatine above the normal limits.
EC8: 8. Taking other drugs known to reduce the metabolism of minocycline and thus increase the probability of toxicity.
